nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum

segments.oily: The one reviewer who identifies as oily-prone reports the serum does not add extra oil or shine, though another reviewer with dry skin cautions the product's oily undertone might not suit oily skin.
segments.dry: Dry skin is the most consistently addressed segment, with reviewers describing relief from flaky, rough, or stubborn dry patches and specifically strong hydration in winter or from frequent air travel; several combine it with mentions of aging or mature skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who describes it as mixed oily and dry, report the serum works well and gives refreshed, hydrated, glowy results.
segments.sensitive: Reports from sensitive skin conflict sharply: one reviewer says the serum dried, irritated, and burned her sensitive skin within two days, while another with 'super sensitive' skin reports no irritation at all and recommends it as a gentle, youth-restoring option; a third suggests it may not suit those very sensitive to fragrance.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as aging or mature, from their 30s through nearly 50, report smoother, tighter, better-hydrated skin, with one specifically noting it helped with the dry, rough skin that comes with age and another finding it necessary to layer a moisturizer on top for enough hydration at her age.

concerns.aging: Reviewers addressing aging or mature skin report tighter, firmer-feeling skin, including improvement around the neck, alongside better hydration; one notes the serum alone isn't enough for her mature skin and recommends layering a moisturizer on top for sufficient results.
concerns.dehydration: The vast majority of reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration, often citing relief for dull, dry, or dehydrated-looking skin within days of regular use. Two reviewers dissent sharply: one says it dried out and irritated her skin, and another felt it left her skin neither moisturized nor clean after application.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer tracking redness reports a visible decrease in redness alongside smoother skin texture after regular use.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer focused on barrier support says the serum's oils help maintain her skin barrier in addition to hydrating it.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer tracking dark spots reports the serum significantly reduced them after two weeks of twice-daily use, alongside an overall glow.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin, including one managing dryness from prescription acne treatments, report the serum's oil layer did not cause new breakouts or clogged pores despite initial hesitation about using an oil-based product.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including some who normally get oily quickly, report the oil layer absorbs fully without adding shine or greasiness; one exception says her skin stays a bit oily throughout the day after application and suspects it may not suit oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Must shake bottle to blend oil and serum layers
Fragrance can feel strong or overpowering
Concentrated formula, good value per use
Slightly tacky feel right after applying, fades quickly

extraits.texte: This serum is too scented, definitely not suited for sensitive skin! It dried out, irritated, and gave me a burning feeling after truinf it out for 2 days. So disappointing because their packaging is quite nice but serum content is so watery, cheap, and aggresive!

I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like d'Alba products and I had high expectations from this serum. It didn't disappoint. I really like how hydrating the serum is. I felt my skin stays a bit oily throughout the day even with little product and my skin is on the dryer side. I don't mind the feeling but it might not work for oily skin people. It has a slight fragrance to it which doesn't linger and I like it. Overall its a good product.

extraits.titre: Love the Oil and Serum Combo
extraits.texte: I've been really enjoying the d'Alba Piedmont Double Layer Revitalizing Serum. I'm in my 30s with dry, aging skin, and this has been a nice addition to my routine. It has a light scent that smells luxurious but isn't overpowering at all. I also really like the oil and serum combination. You can actually see the separate liquids in the bottle. The oil layer is meant to help moisturize while the serum layer helps hydrate and brighten the skin. Once shaken together, it creates a lightweight formula that absorbs quickly. The serum spreads easily and doesn't feel sticky or heavy. After using it for a while, I noticed my skin looked brighter and felt smoother and silkier. It also layers really well with other products. I found it works especially well under a moisturizer and doesn't pill. I used it mostly during the day and liked how fresh and hydrated my skin felt throughout the day. Overall, it's a nice lightweight serum that adds brightness and softness to the skin and works well as part of a daytime skincare routine.

I'm a flight attendant flirting with 50, so my skin is mature and spending most of my days on airplanes and in hotel rooms dries my skin out. I was excited that d'Alba kindly gave me this White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum for free so that I could review it. I tested it daily for two weeks before this review. I used it with makeup and found that it doesn't cause foundation to crease or pill and everything stays in place. This serum gives my skin an extra boost of hydration and works really well on my neck. I haven't had any breakouts and leaves my skin very soft and not sticky. I feel that it works best with a moisturizer on top; using it alone isn't enough. At my age, an extra shot of hydration is necessary. I'll definitely continue to use this and other d'Alba products because Korean skincare is top shelf!

extraits.titre: Does not irritate my sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I love the d'Alba brand and recently added the Double Layer Revitalizing Serum to my skincare regimen, and what a difference in my skin! I am using this in the morning and evening on my freshly washed (and toned) face, neck and upper chest. The results were noticeable right away, my skin looks and feels smoother. My neck feels tighter, and I can feel it working! I love the quality of ingredients; the white truffles are sourced from Italy. The best part is I can use this amazing youth-restoring serum without any irritation to my super sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: I was skeptical of the fragrance but it proved me wrong!!
extraits.texte: I have acne prone skin, using benzoyl peroxide and tretnoin 0.05% to treat acne actually made my skin so dry that one moisturizer was not cutting it, this serum however layered so well under my moisturizer at night and under my sunscreen in the morning, my skin was hydrated and i actually felt my skin being plump and glowy, the fragrance did not break me out, which was the most surprising part! I found a new staple in my routine!!

[I received this product for free for my honest review] I used the product daily for last 2 weeks. I have dark spots on my face. I was using this in the morning and at night. It had significantly reduced the dark spots. My skin is glowing. I recommend to test it on your skin on a small patch first to see you are allergic to it or not. I find this profit very effective for me since it reduced the dark spot.
